subject: Hosted API integration — technical deep-dive & availability
messages:
From: Sasha Kovács <sasha.kovacs@magnatech.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: eng-team@magnatech.com
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — technical deep-dive & availability

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Tim and I want to pull together a technical deep-dive for our engineering team to walk through integration patterns. Key items we want covered: SDK options, streaming (server and client-side), function/tool calling for internal ops triggers, and guidance on batching/prefix caching.

Are you and one of your engineers available next week for a 60-90 minute session? Our preferred window is Thu Apr 16 between 9:30–13:00 PDT. If that doesn't work we can do Fri the 17th in the afternoon.

Also, could you share a short agenda and any pre-read materials (API contract, sample SDK snippets)? We'll invite our infra and backend leads.

—Sasha
Sasha Kovács
Head of Platform Engineering, MagnaTech
[sasha.kovacs@magnatech.com]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: sasha.kovacs@magnatech.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — technical deep-dive & availability

Hi Sasha — great to hear. Thu Apr 16 between 9:30–13:00 PDT works for us. I've penciled in 10:00–11:30 PDT to give us 90 minutes.

Proposed agenda (high level):
- Introductions & objectives (5 min)
- Hosted API architecture overview and model variant routing (10 min)
- SDK options (Python/TS) and best practices (15 min)
- Streaming patterns: client streaming, server streaming, handling reconnects (20 min)
- Function/tool calling demo and safe sandboxing patterns (15 min)
- Batching, KV/prefix caching, and throughput tuning (15 min)
- Q&A and next steps (10 min)

I've attached a short pre-read (redwood-hosted-api-arch.pdf) and a one-page agenda (deep-dive-agenda.md).

Karthik will join for the initial customer context and Steph will field the SDK deep-dive and streaming examples. If you want Markus (solutions architect) on the call for pricing/throughput planning we can include him — let me know.

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm the time and attendee list.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-hosted-api-arch.pdf (PDF, 1.1 MB)
Attachment: deep-dive-agenda.md (Markdown, 2 KB)

From: sasha.kovacs@magnatech.com <sasha.kovacs@magnatech.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: tim.lee@mgmtcorp.com, eng-team@magnatech.com
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — technical deep-dive & availability

Thanks Marissa — 10:00–11:30 PDT on Thu works. Please include Steph for SDK/streaming.

One small ask: can you call out whether the streaming path supports incremental function/tool calls (i.e., emitting tool calls mid-stream) and any latency implications for small token budgets? Our infra lead will want to size the reserved capacity accordingly.

We'll invite: myself, Tim Lee (CTO), and two backend engineers (alias eng-team).

—Sasha

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: sasha.kovacs@magnatech.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 06:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — technical deep-dive & availability

Hi Sasha — great question. Short answer: yes, our streaming API supports mid-stream function/tool calls. We'll demonstrate an example where the model emits a CALL event that triggers a tool invocation and then resumes token streaming. We'll also show performance numbers for short token windows and how routing to lower-latency model variants affects end-to-end latency.

I've booked the 10:00–11:30 PDT slot and sent a calendar invite (link below). Invite includes a 'technical' subagenda with specific endpoints and sample code snippets we'll run live.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-magna-tech-20260416
Pre-read folder: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/eng/HostedAPI/Integration-Notes

If you need to move the time for timezone reasons for any attendee, tell me and we can shift to 11:00–12:30 PDT.

Best,
Marissa

From: tim.lee@mgmtcorp.com <tim.lee@mgmtcorp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sasha.kovacs@magnatech.com
Cc: eng-team@magnatech.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — technical deep-dive & availability

Hi all — small update from our side: two of our backend engineers had an overlap and asked if we could move the call 30 minutes later to 10:30–12:00 PDT. That still gives 90 minutes but shifts the window.

If that's okay for Redwood, we'll accept the invite update. Otherwise we can proceed as planned.

On Thu we'll ask a couple of targeted items:
- Example of function call sandboxing and replayability
- SDK example for streaming in Node with reconnect logic
- Quick walkthrough of reserved capacity sizing for a 50 RPS baseline with 200ms token targets
